summary: BMO 2023-C4 Mortgage Trust filed an 8-K disclosing a change in special servicer for two of its mortgage loans (575 Broadway and Gilardian NYC Portfolio) under the FIVE 2023-V1 Mortgage Trust PSA. Effective September 1, 2026, C-IV Asset Management LLC succeeded Greystone Servicing Company LLC as special servicer, with the related Assignment and Assumption Agreement filed as Exhibit 20.1. This is a routine servicing administrative change, not a special situation. No deal terms, prices, or strategic actions involved. The filing is informational, and no event warrants special-situations classification; the focus remains on the trust's performance and servicer oversight.
